title.zh: 律师专业法（第 75B 条指定生效日）公告
title.en: Legal Profession Act (Appointed Day for purposes of Section 75B) Notification

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. This Notification may be cited as the Legal Profession Act (Appointed Day for purposes of Section 75B) Notification1.

2. For the purposes of section 75B of the Act1, the appointed day referred to therein shall be 1st September 1998.
1 The Legal Profession Act (Cap. 161, 1997 Ed.)
[G.N. No. S 383/98]
